'''CS-9147''' was a [[human]] from the [[Otomok system]] who served the [[First Order]] as a [[First Order jet trooper|jet trooper]]. In [[35 ABY]], CS-9147 and another jet [[Soldier|trooper]] [[Mission to Pasaana (Resistance)|pursued]] the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and her [[Resistance]] allies through the [[desert]]s of the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]]. The two destroyed their foes' [[skimmer]]s but were ultimately [[Death|killed]] by its crew.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|C-3PO|They fly now!|Finn|They fly now?|Dameron|They fly now.|attr=C-3PO, Finn, and Poe Dameron spot the two jet troopers|src=<ref name="TROS" />}}
CS-9147 was a [[human]] born in the [[Otomok system]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> around [[10 ABY]]<ref name="Birthdate" /> who served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps (First Order)|Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[First Order]] as a [[First Order jet trooper|jet trooper]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> CS-9147 and another jet trooper were amongst a [[division]] of [[First Order military|First Order forces]] deployed to the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]] to search for the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and her allies in the [[Resistance]]. One of the two jet troopers spotted their targets fleeing on [[skimmer]]s from the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] in the [[Forbidden Valley]] and alerted the other First Order forces.<ref name="TROS" />

CS-9147 and the other jet trooper gave chase on the back of two [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers']] respective [[125-Z treadspeeder bike]]s, launching from the vehicles and opening fire on the skimmers. Their targets split up, with Resistance members [[Finn]], [[Poe Dameron]], and [[C-3PO]] heading down a narrow valley in their [[HS-19 cargo loading transport skimmer]]. One treadbike followed them down the valley, but the two jet troopers and remaining treadspeeder continued chasing Rey, [[Chewbacca]], and [[BB-8]] as they remained in the open [[desert]] on an [[Arunskin 75D skimmer]].<ref name="TROS" />

After the treadspeeder was destroyed, Chewbacca managed to shoot down one of the two jet troopers with his [[bowcaster]]. After the two skimmers reunited, the second jet trooper managed to destroy both vehicles, but was [[Death|killed]] when the skimmers' occupants survived and returned fire.<ref name="TROS" />

==Personality and traits==
CS-9147 stood 1.8 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
CS-9147 wore white [[First Order stormtrooper armor|jet trooper armor]], including a [[NJP-900 integrated jetpack]] and a [[helmet]]. The trooper carried a [[G125 projectile launcher]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
CS-9147 was created for the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Only two jet troopers appear in the film,<ref name="TROS" /> but the ''Visual Dictionary'' does not provide enough information to distinguish which of the two is CS-9147.<ref name="TROS VD" />
